# Theatrical Fabrics, Stage Curtains & Production Supplies

## North America’s Largest Seller of Theatrical Fabrics, Curtains & Supplies

Rose Brand caters to the entertainment and event industries, celebrating over 100 years in business. Customers rely on us to help create beautiful, functional, entertaining environments, whether it's within a high school auditorium, church, Broadway stage, event space, arena, or convention hall. Use our products and custom solutions to improve your venue or show aesthetics and functionality.

We offer thousands of production supplies from the largest inventory in the industry, as well elaborate custom products and services manufactured by our custom sewing and technical experts. Custom soft goods and hardware solutions run the gamut from plain black stage drapes for masking or soundproofing, to the fanciest theatre main curtains running on automated curtain track systems.

## Products and Custom Solutions That Fit Your Specific Needs

Rose Brand offers thousands of ready-to-ship theatrical fabrics, scenic paints, gaffers tapes, rental curtains, production hardware and supplies. Custom solutions include stage drapes, commercial curtains, cycs, scrims, printed backdrops, projection screens, curtain track, and theatrical automation. Let our experts guide you to the best products and services that fulfill your creative and technical goals.
